items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team will monitor this week before determining availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Exited Week 1 with chest/rib; Harbaugh DTD
items.implication: Monitor practice; if out, boost to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris/Omarion Hampton

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim; realistic chance returns Week 2 vs Chargers. Working hard to play ASAP per coach.
items.why: Meniscus trim last week; short recovery expected
items.implication: If active, elite TE1; Mayer holds value as handcuff/2TE

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day. Would have returned if playoff game. MRI upcoming but optimistic.
items.why: Aggravation but sources say mild; coach positive
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or limited; Bateman/Likely upside if sits

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving share in debut with Mahomes
items.implication: Locked-in RB1 every-week starter with massive opportunity
items.opportunity: 29/32 RB opps, 19 routes, 22% target share, GL work implied

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 99 Utilization Score, 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 carries + 6 targets for 156 yards + 2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down player.
items.why: Dominant multi-phase share in new scheme with better OL
items.implication: Treat as top-5 RB ROS; buy if available

items.text: Travis Etienne only 58% snaps, 43% attempts, 38% routes despite Kamara out. Three-way committee. Downgrades to low-end RB2; Kamara return further muddies.
items.why: Unexpected split even without Kamara; low route share
items.implication: Flex/RB3 range; monitor Kamara status closely

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme target/carry funnel to core four in high-powered offense
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore depth pieces
items.opportunity: 93% of team opportunities; zero meaningful RB2/WR3/TE2

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated by TD but usage solid: 8 carries, 21 routes, 7/7 targets. Only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes and GL; healthy return
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; hold/start confidently

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, expected out several weeks/multi-game absence.
items.implication: Depletes BAL WR depth with Flowers also dinged; Bateman upgrade

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown high ankle sprain, placed on IR, expected to miss ~6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed, IR designation
items.implication: Major hit to Maye/NE pass game; no clear WR1 replacement short-term

items.text: David Montgomery clear RB1 on ground (65% attempts, all inside-5, short-yardage lead) despite 50/50 reports. Upgrades to high-end RB2; Marks two-minute specialist.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited receiving role; committee persists post-injury
items.implication: Low floor without volume; Sampson absence not full boost

items.text: Lions RB Isiah Pacheco surgery to remove body pressing on nerve in back; 12-week recovery, possible early December return. Originally MCL then back issue.
items.implication: Gibbs even more heavily featured; Lions may seek RB depth

items.text: Malik Nabers officially active for Week 1 after knee uncertainty.
items.implication: Full WR1 role restored; monitor snaps/routes post-return
